mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts above 1700 and retail sales above 340000 indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings support.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1700 and RSAFS > 340000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 115 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 115, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation measured by CPIAUCSL below 195 indicates stable price environment that reduces real interest rate volatility, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 195, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Negative monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS change < 0) signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS change < 0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts above 1700 and quarterly GDP above 10800 indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1700 and GDPC1 > 10800, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 120 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 120, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.
